messages:
Harper: quick heads-up — customer-facing guide /kb/getting-started has a broken image (screenshot loads 403) and an anchor link that jumps to top of page. Noticed during demo. Anyone own the guide? :grimacing: Drew: ugh thanks. Which image path? and which anchor? Harper: image path is /assets/images/guides/quickstart-screenshot.png -> 403. anchor is `#setup-quickstart-step-3` but page now has heading 'Step 3 — Configure keys' so slug might be different. Megan (Docs): good catch. That image was recently rehosted to our CDN; looks like the ACL didn't include the docs bucket. I can add a short ACL fix. For the anchor, easiest immediate fix is adding a compat id on the heading. link-audit-bot: nightly media-scan detected 1 image 403 on /kb/getting-started and 2 orphan fragments pointing to `#setup-quickstart-step-3`. Created ticket KB-9901. Drew: Plan: 1) hotfix image ACL so screenshot returns 200, 2) add compat id for the anchor, 3) sweep callers to update canonical slug. Who can open a tiny PR combining 1 and 2? Megan (Docs): I'll open PR. I'll add an explicit img path that points to the CDN canonical url and a small header id: `

Step 3 — Configure keys

` so old links keep working. Also add a comment to remind editors about media rehost. Harper: please canary to staging first; the onboarding email references that image and marketing caches thumbnails. Megan (Docs): will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10011 — adds ACL fix instructions in the deploy script, swaps image to CDN canonical path, and adds compat anchor id. Tagging @Drew for ops ACL change. QA-bot: lint checks passed. staging deploy queued for branch fix/media-anchor-8090012345. Linkcheck pending. Drew: I pushed the ACL update to CDN bucket policy. Staging canary looks green for the image URL (200) and the fragment now jumps correctly. Harper: tested staging: image loads, fragment deep-link works from onboarding email preview and handbook TOC. No auth popups. Megan (Docs): merging to prod after one more quick LGTM from docs. Also filing KB-9902 to add the image path to the media-monitor whitelist so future rehosts don't break. Drew: LGTM. Nice quick turnaround. Megan (Docs): merged and deployed to prod. Thanks all. I'll follow up with a tiny PR to update other callers to the canonical slug and add owners for the handbook page. Harper: big win — saved a demo. :tada:
